title: Debounce a local search until typing pauses
goal: uses clearTimeout and setTimeout to combine high-frequency inputs into one operation.
summary: The event will be triggered every time a character is entered in the search box. The user pauses for 220 milliseconds before executing the query with the last input.
tasks: Listen for input on #filter. On each change, cancel the previous timer and schedule the existing runSearch function for 220 milliseconds later.
Use the latest input as the query. Continuous typing triggers one search. Typing again after a pause can trigger another one.

example.note: The timer number needs to be saved outside the callback so that the next event can cancel the previous schedule.

hint: Put array filtering or result update in delayed callback. Each input updates the saved timer number.
